source_references.notes: Browser red-spot weighted centroid with a documented data dictionary and proposed validation protocol.
Related weighted red centroid and peak-to-peak window aggregation with explicit physics and validation limits.

known_boundaries: The direct observation is an image-space light-spot centroid, not mechanical displacement.
Peak-to-peak spot range is not single-sided amplitude.
Formal metrology, repeatability, and uncertainty evidence is not yet present in the source repositories.
